verbatim_quote.english_translation: If approved, note it as technical approval (PO_REVIEW_PENDING path).

extracted_decision.summary: Ruled that Code Reviewer approval is technical approval only and task must enter PO_REVIEW_PENDING path.
extracted_decision.rationale: Separate technical sign-off from product owner review.
alternatives: Require PO review before technical approval
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Adds PO review step and delays final closure; Maintains governance and separation of duties
